results.summary: The loops and offsets match, but the code omits separate pointer loads used for the calls.
issues: The first loop loads field_4 once and reuses it as the call argument. The P-code loads field_4 separately for vtable lookup and for the argument.
The second loop similarly caches DAT_00cf1944, while the decompilation reads it for the vtable lookup and again as the call argument.
validation_findings: Candidate must contain exactly one complete function body
